removal.text: Support the engine, disconnect the battery, remove the under-engine cover and drain the cooling circuit.
Remove the accessory and timing belts using the K4M timing procedure, then remove the camshaft pulleys with the specified locking tool.
Disconnect the fuel feed, ignition coils, air-temperature and camshaft-position wiring, dephaser connector, vacuum hose and intake/exhaust attachments.
Remove the camshaft carrier and valvetrain components, disconnect cylinder-head coolant hoses and wiring, then lift off the cylinder head.

installation.text: Clean mating faces without scratching aluminium; keep all oil passages free of debris and inspect the head for distortion and cracks.
Fit the gasket and head, then use the K4M-specific bolt-check and tightening sequence from the complete Renault powertrain values procedure; values are intentionally not supplied here.
Reinstall valvetrain parts, set camshaft orientation and restore the timing, intake, exhaust, cooling and electrical connections.

checks: Pressure-test the head for cracks.
Refill and bleed the cooling circuit; verify oil and coolant levels and check for leaks.

faults.causes: Possible gasket failure or cylinder-head distortion; diagnose before dismantling.

removal.text: Secure the vehicle to the lift, disconnect the battery, remove front wheels, undertray and wheel-arch liners, then drain engine oil/coolant and recover refrigerant as required.
Remove the front bumper and front panel; disconnect K4M fuel feed, cooling hoses, intake duct, ECU harness, grounds, exhaust sensors and gearbox controls.
Disconnect clutch hydraulics and driveshafts, remove exhaust and lower radiator crossmember, then attach the load positioner.
Remove the engine and gearbox pendulum supports and lower the complete engine/gearbox assembly under controlled support.

installation.text: Position the engine/gearbox assembly and reinstall its pendulum supports, torque link and disconnected systems.
Reconnect and secure all lines and wiring; refill engine oil, gearbox oil as required, coolant and refrigerant, then bleed the clutch and cooling system.
Apply the listed torques only to the matching fasteners and verify brake hoses/ABS wiring are correctly routed before road testing.

checks: Check for fuel, oil, coolant and refrigerant leaks.
Verify clutch operation, gear selection, brake feel, and that no harness or hose contacts moving/hot components.

checks: Check for misfire faults and confirm each coil connector is latched.

summary: K4M petrol-tank removal requires lowering the exhaust, moving the vapour canister and supporting the tank. The tank fastener torque is explicitly listed for the K4M application.

removal.text: Drain the tank, disconnect the battery, remove the undertray and exhaust as required, then disconnect vapour-canister hoses and fuel-line clips.

installation.text: Reform and refit the heat shield without contact against the tank; renew tank-hose clamps and reconnect fuel lines.
Tighten tank fasteners to the sourced torque and verify every fuel connection is fully latched.

checks: Check for fuel leaks and ensure the heat shield and exhaust cannot contact the tank.

name: Evaporative-emissions charcoal canister
summary: The petrol-vapour canister is mounted on the tank. Disconnect tank-vapour, purge-valve and fresh-air lines before releasing it from its retaining slot.

installation.text: Reconnect each line to its original port and seat the canister fully in its tank retaining slot.

checks: Confirm the hoses are correctly routed and the tank vent is not blocked.
